run.name: Centene Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (CNC)
run.summary: Credit quality improved in 2026 as debt fell and earnings recovered, but earnings are front-loaded, parent cash is thin and the business depends on government rates and regulation. The view is adequate and improving, not yet secure. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CENTENE CORP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. LTM to September 30, 2026; the issuer prints no EBITDA, so this is an analyst definition. Net debt deducts 376; consolidated cash is not used because it is mostly regulated. C4

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Interest paid LTM of 627. Interest paid is total cash interest; no split by instrument is printed. C4

cash.basis: Cash. No revolver borrowings (Q3 10-Q page:47). Unregulated cash 376, of which 175 available for general corporate use. Revolver matures March 5, 2030

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, guarantors and the receivable purchase agreement are not supplied, and the issuer reports no EBITDA, so leverage rests on an analyst definition.
CP-1 main limitation: The issuer reports no EBITDA, so every leverage and cover ratio uses an analyst definition; covenant definitions and executed agreements are not supplied.
